title: A Kernel-Based Density of States Estimator for Quantum Computing
summary: The density of states (DoS) encodes the thermodynamic and spectral properties of quantum many-body systems, yet its reconstruction becomes intractable for Hilbert spaces too large to diagonalize. Classically, the kernel polynomial method (KPM) addresses this by combining stochastic trace estimation with a smoothing kernel. Here we show that the Rodeo algorithm---one of the simplest eigenvalue-location protocols for near-term quantum hardware---provides a direct quantum analogue of this approach.
